search_text: published ZDI-20-547 ZDI-CAN-10266 (Pwn2Own) Triangle Microworks SCADA Data Gateway DNP3 GET_FILE_INFO Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-04-16 CVE-2020-10615 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-10615 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Triangle MicroWorks'] ['SCADA Data Gateway'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Triangle Microworks SCADA Data Gateway. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists with the handling of opcodes for GET_FILE_INFO. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerablity to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Triangle MicroWorks has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
